info.description: This is the mzTab validation service.
info.title: mzTab validation API.

get.summary: Returns version, validation engines, limits and analytics settings

post.description: Converts an mzTab-M file in JSON representation to tab separated mzTab-M. Comments are not written. Unless validate is false, the written file is parsed again, and its errors are reported with 422; their line numbers refer to the written file.

parameters.description: Whether to parse the written file again and report its errors.
parameters.name: validate

requestBody.description: The mzTab-M file in JSON representation.

400.description: The request body is not mzTab-M JSON

413.description: The file is larger than the upload limit

422.description: The model could not be written, or the written file has errors

503.description: Too many files are being validated or converted; try again after Retry-After seconds

post.description: Converts a tab separated mzTab-M file to its JSON representation. A file with errors is reported with 422.

200.description: The mzTab-M file in JSON representation

413.description: The file is larger than the upload limit

503.description: Too many files are being validated or converted; try again after Retry-After seconds

post.summary: Starts a validation of an example file

post.description: Validates an mzTab file in JSON representation and reports syntactic, structural, and semantic errors.

parameters.description: The level of errors that should be reported, one of error, warn, info.
parameters.name: level

parameters.description: The maximum number of errors to return.
parameters.name: maxErrors

parameters.description: Whether a semantic validation against the default rule set should be performed.
parameters.name: semanticValidation

requestBody.description: mzTab file that should be validated.

400.description: The request body is not mzTab-M JSON

413.description: The file is larger than the upload limit

503.description: Too many files are being validated or converted; try again after Retry-After seconds

post.description: Validates an mzTab file in plain text representation and reports syntactic, structural, and semantic errors.

parameters.description: The level of errors that should be reported, one of error, warn, info.
parameters.name: level

parameters.description: The maximum number of errors to return.
parameters.name: maxErrors

parameters.description: Whether a semantic validation against the default rule set should be performed.
parameters.name: semanticValidation

requestBody.description: mzTab file that should be validated.

413.description: The file is larger than the upload limit

503.description: Too many files are being validated or converted; try again after Retry-After seconds

get.summary: Lists the available validation profiles (latest version of each)

post.summary: Starts a validation of an uploaded mzTab-M file

delete.summary: Deletes a validation and its stored data

get.summary: Returns the state and result of a validation
Lists the metadata groups of a validated file

parameters.description: A metadata key of the group; the page that holds it is returned and page is ignored
parameters.name: key

get.summary: Returns one page of a metadata group
Downloads the validation messages as CSV or JSON

parameters.description: COLUMN:text, repeatable; the column is the first ':'-prefix that is an exact column name, the rest is the text (not split at commas)
parameters.name: filter

get.summary: Returns one page of the SML, SMF or SME table
